attributes.description: Identifies web requests to URLs that serve Ashen Bobbin ransomware payloads, as reported in campaign PTF-03848. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.

attributes.name: Ashen Bobbin Ransomware: Request to known payload URL (PTF-03848)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Ashen Bobbin Ransomware: Request to known payload URL

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Ashen Bobbin ransomware in campaign PTF-03848.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
